question: Why is the sacred seat identified by the name praṇava in this teaching?
premises: The seat is characterized as mere praise of excellence.
Praṇava is the name assigned to it.
The naming reflects that supreme excellence.
inference: Because it is mere praise of excellence, the seat is named praṇava.
uncertainties: The phrase prakarṣanutimātratvāt admits more than one doctrinal interpretation.
plain_english: Because it is nothing but the praise of supreme excellence, the seat is called praṇava.
